scope:
Compare live original/native simulation for coherent authored mission launches.

Inputs are either neutral or a repeatable player-control sequence. The comparison
covers the specified simulation interval; campaign completion is checked separately.
Captured GO handoffs retain authored activation, sides, objectives and roster. Each
simulation starts its original generator with an explicitly repeatable warm-up.
Original output is captured before C++ runs and is never supplied as native state.

offset_overflow_repair.effect: XOR ECX,ECX replaces SBB ECX,ECX before XOR ECX,8192; use +8192 for all products
